summary: Unpinned GitHub fork as runtime dependency enables install-time code execution
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, npm resolves this to whatever is at the branch HEAD of that GitHub repository at the moment of install and runs any lifecycle scripts shipped in that repo. The source is a personal fork (wanzchil) rather than a registry-published, version-pinned release, so the fork owner can change what executes on every install at any time without any package or version change here. There is no integrity check and no version lock on this off-registry source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
